Subject: StellarSys – MSA + Order Form (kickoff)

Hi Mina / Monica,

Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. Attaching our current MSA and a draft Order Form so we can kick off legal review. We want to get a signed MSA and order form in place before the pilot starts (target: mid-May).

Quick context / asks from our side:
- Please confirm Redwood's standard MSA template you intend to use and whether you have a preferred version for public-sector customers.
- We need to surface: legal entity for billing, country of data residency, key contacts for security & procurement, and any standard exhibits (IP, Data Processing Addendum).
- Also: can you share your SOC2 Type II report and the standard order form exhibit template?

Attachments:
- Stellarsys_MSA_Submitted_v1.docx
- Stellarsys_OrderForm_Draft.xlsx
- ExhibitA_Party_Roster.xlsx (blank template)
- SOC2_Type2_Stellarsys_2025.pdf

If you can send a brief list of the party details (billing entity, address, tax ID) and an outline of likely redline items from Redwood by end of day Tue (04/06), that would help our procurement team plan the timeline.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement, StellarSys

Subject: Re: StellarSys – MSA + Order Form (kickoff)

Elena — thanks for the materials and clear asks. Attaching Redwood's standard MSA template so legal has a starting point.

High-level next steps from our side:
1) Redwood to review Stellarsys MSA + Order Form and send an initial redline (legal) by EOD 04/06.
2) We will request party details from our billing team; please fill the ExhibitA template and return to us if convenient.
3) Security: Monica will coordinate on SOC2 exchange and any additional questionnaire.

Items we need from you to speed this up:
- Confirm billing entity (full legal name and billing address) and invoice contact.
- Confirm whether any data residency requirement exists for the pilot (region / country).
- Highlight any non-standard clauses you expect (e.g., reverse IP assignment, unusually broad audit rights, bespoke indemnities).

Attachments:
- Redwood_MSA_Template_v2.docx (Redwood standard; includes DPA exhibit)
- ExhibitA_Party_Roster.xlsx (please populate and return)

I'll loop in our contracts lead (Marissa) and renewals/ops (Tessa) on the follow-up so we have coverage for redlines and billing.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad

Mina / Monica — quick follow with the ExhibitA filled and a few notes inline on the Order Form. See attached ExhibitA_Party_Roster.xlsx (completed) and a redline summary that our GC asked me to surface:
- Data residency: pilot data must remain in the US (no EU processing).
- Audit rights: want annual audit rights with 30 days notice; preferred wording in paragraph 12.
- Liability cap: seeking carveouts for IP indemnity.

Attachments:
- ExhibitA_Party_Roster.xlsx (completed)
- Stellarsys_OrderForm_Draft_filled.xlsx

Let us know if Redwood needs a corporate PO for the appraisal phase — procurement can issue once we confirm the billing entity in ExhibitA.

Thanks,
Elena
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-07T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: StellarSys – MSA + Order Form (kickoff) — initial redline plan

Marissa / Tessa — forwarding Stellarsys materials and their completed Exhibit A. Mina already attached our template. Can you do an initial pass and call out any high risk items? Quick notes from the CS intake:
- Data residency: US-only requirement — highlight if this impacts any of Redwood's routing or hosting policy; may need to reserve dedicated region or deployment constraint.
- Audit rights: customer requests annual onsite audit language; propose counter: SOC2 + right to request reasonable evidence, not unfettered onsite audits.
- Liability: they want IP indemnity carveouts; flag for Legal.

Proposed timeline:
- 04/07 afternoon: Legal (Marissa) to provide initial redline + risk summary.
- 04/08: CS + Procurement call to review redlines and agree on negotiation owners.

Attachments in thread: Stellarsys_MSA_Submitted_v1.docx; Stellarsys_OrderForm_Draft.xlsx; ExhibitA_Party_Roster.xlsx; SOC2_Type2_Stellarsys_2025.pdf; Redwood_MSA_Template_v2.docx

Please reply with any blockers; if none, Marissa please note high-priority items and estimated turnaround.

Thanks — Monica
